description: A muted forest-green wool apron dress over an opaque natural cream linen shift with a simple neckline at the collarbones and full sleeves to the wrists. Small plain bronze brooches, restrained warm-grey tablet-woven edging, a narrow woven belt and a closed long skirt; practical brown leather shoes visible below. Near-full modest coverage follows the stated normal physical-confidence layer. Clean, sturdy, modestly prosperous Scandinavian civilian cloth, no heraldry, headwear, armor, fur war gear or weapons.
